answer: Entry is an admission auction on terraced levels: each bidder stakes a deposit for one terrace; only the top bid wins a slot, so one operator cannot claim many cheaply. Each identity carries a unique pigment stamp, so copies leave a visible ripple: identical stamps are flagged and slashed. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 40 = 4,000 units for a 30-unit reward. An honest agent pays once, keeps its terrace 20 epochs, and earns fees from work.
